title: Oyakodon
description: Chicken and egg over rice, cooked in a shallow pan in about eight minutes. The egg goes in twice and never fully sets — that softness is the whole dish.

steps.text: Bring the dashi, soy sauce, mirin, and sugar to a simmer in a small shallow pan.
Add the onion and cook until translucent.
Lay in the chicken in a single layer and simmer until just cooked through.
steps.tip: Do not stir it about. The pieces should stay where you put them.

steps.text: Pour two-thirds of the beaten eggs over in a spiral and cover the pan.
Add the remaining egg, cover again, and pull the pan off the heat while the top is still visibly loose.
steps.tip: Residual heat finishes it. Set egg here means you have gone too far.

steps.text: Slide over hot steamed rice and scatter with spring onions.
